messages.author: f562cc721b7e9a13
messages.subject: Feedback on the layout of this shiny app
parts:
A few quick thoughts viewing your work on the iPhone:

1) Perhaps a compact tab and an expanded tab (what you have now)? The compact tab would have no descriptions but just the text boxes with the description as the default text. This is Nice once you are accustomed to the flow.

2) Remove the description below the entry boxes in lieu of hover links or click to display a pop up description.

Otherwise, a very useful and creative app!

Best regards,
Stephen McDaniel
Chief Data Scientist at Freakalytics
